items.summary: US tech entrepreneur David Friedberg argues the scientific basis for reversing cellular age via 'epigenetic reprogramming' is fully established; the only challenge now is precisely controlling protein dosing to safely rejuvenate cells. This means reversing aging has moved past biology proof-of-concept and become essentially an engineering problem of trial and optimization, with related therapies very likely to reach the market within a few years.
items.summary_zh: 美国科技创业者David Friedberg认为，利用“表观遗传重编程”技术逆转细胞年龄的科学基础已经完全确立，目前的挑战仅在于如何精准控制蛋白质的施加剂量以安全地让细胞恢复年轻，这意味着逆转衰老已经跨越了生物学概念验证阶段，实质上变成了一个只需不断摸索和优化的工程学问题，且相关疗法极有望在未来几年内推向市场

items.title: The worst is over, but is Meituan out of the woods yet?
items.title_zh: 最坏的时候过去了，但美团还没到高兴的时候？
items.summary: Meituan returned to profit in Q2, but structural shifts in the competitive landscape make it hard for its margins to return to former highs.
items.summary_zh: 美团二季度重返盈利，但竞争格局的结构性改变令其利润率难以回到昔日高点

items.title: JPMorgan's 'most accurate of 2026' trading desk 'shifts again': ends its June-era bullishness, turns 'tactically cautious' on US stocks
items.title_zh: “2026最准”的摩根大通交易台“再变”：结束6月以来看多，对美股转为“战术谨慎”
items.summary: JPMorgan's Market Intelligence desk has won wide attention this year with a string of precise market-turning-point calls, but now shifts stance again — from bullish to 'tactical caution/neutral' — citing rising uncertainty over the Fed's policy path, crowded positioning, seasonal pressure and a sharp momentum-factor drawdown.
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通市场情报交易台今年以来凭借一系列精准的市场转折点判断赢得广泛关注，如今再度调整立场——由看多转为"战术谨慎/中性"， 理由是美联储政策路径不确定性上升、市场定位拥挤、季节性压力以及动量因子大幅回撤

items.title: This article that swept Silicon Valley recounts the detailed story of the first large-scale AI loss-of-control in human history
items.title_zh: 这篇硅谷刷屏的文章，讲述了人类历史上第一次大规模AI失控的详细经过
items.summary: I recently read an article that, upon release, immediately swept across all of Silicon Valley, garnering over 10 million reads on X alone in a single day.
items.summary_zh: 最近看了一篇文章，这篇文章发布后立刻刷屏整个硅谷，一天内仅在X平台就有超过1000万次阅读

items.title: Goldman Sachs raises its humanoid-robot market-size forecast fourfold; e-commerce warehouses and auto production lines to adopt first
items.title_zh: 高盛将人形机器人市场规模预测上调4倍，电商仓库和汽车生产线最快应用
items.summary: Recently, Goldman Sachs internet and e-commerce equity analyst and Managing Director Eric Sheridan published an 80-page 'Physical AI' research report to clients, broadly raising humanoid-robot market forecasts and expecting warehouse logistics to be the first battleground to ignite.
items.summary_zh: 近日，高盛互联网与电商股票分析师、董事总经理Eric Sheridan向客户发布了一份长达80页的"物理AI"研究报告，将人形机器人市场预测全面上调，并预计仓储物流成为最先爆发的战场

items.title: The $3 trillion oil market has just gotten more accessible than ever: No longer a 'rich man's game'
items.title_zh: 规模3万亿美元的石油市场从未如此触手可及：不再是“富人的游戏”
items.summary: Oil trading is becoming more accessible to individual investors as smaller futures contracts, ETFs and online brokerages lower longtime barriers to the market.
items.summary_zh: 随着更小的期货合约、ETF和在线券商降低了长期存在的市场门槛，石油交易正变得对个人投资者更加可及。

items.title: Is VLA no longer enough? WAM is rebuilding embodied intelligence's 'strongest brain' and the hardware value chain
items.title_zh: VLA不够用了？WAM正在重构具身智能“最强大脑”与硬件价值链
items.summary: Competition in embodied intelligence is shifting from 'can the robot move' to 'can it understand and predict the physical world'.
items.summary_zh: 具身智能竞争正在从“机器人能不能动”转向“能不能理解并预测物理世界”

items.title: US floats a 'debt-resolution plan' at the G20: Bessent and Warsh jointly call 'the only way out of the bind is growth'
items.title_zh: 美国在G20抛出“化债方案”：贝森特、沃什齐声呼吁“走出困境的唯一途径是增长”
items.summary: On August 31, the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting opened in Asheville, North Carolina, USA.
items.summary_zh: 8月31日，二十国集团（G20）财长与央行行长会议在美国北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔开幕
